q1.a: You get a private link. Send it over WhatsApp or anywhere — they tap it and the animated experience plays right in their browser. Nothing to install.

q2.q: How does payment work for premium templates?
q2.a: We show you an InstaPay number. You transfer the amount, upload a screenshot and reference, and once our team confirms it your link unlocks automatically.

q3.a: Yes. Every template works fully in Arabic (right-to-left) and English, including fonts and animations.

q4.a: Your experiences live in your dashboard. You can keep drafts, duplicate ideas, and manage your shareable links any time.
